ModelContractSection.contentEn: The term of the lease is not less than two years. Shorter terms are not valid for residential houses under this proclamation.

ModelContractSection.contentAm: ቤቱ በአድራሻ (ክፍለ ከተማ፣ ወረዳ)፣ በስፋት፣ በክፍል ቁጥር፣ እና በሁኔታው (አዲስ የተጠናቀቀ፣ ባዶ፣ የተረከበ) ይገለጻል፤ ሁኔታው የይበዛና ዘመን ማስላት ይወስናል።
ModelContractSection.contentOm: Mana nyyata teessoo (kutaa magaalaa, woreda), bal'ina, lakkoofsa kutaa, fi haalaan (ijaarama haaraa, duwwaa, qabame) ibbama; haalli saanduqa yeroo ittiin bahu murteessa.

ModelContractSection.contentEn: The term of the lease is not less than two years. Shorter terms are not valid for residential houses under this proclamation.
ModelContractSection.contentAm: የኪራይ ዘመን ከሁለት ዓመት አይቀንስም። ከዚህ በታች የሆነ ዘመን በዚህ አዋጅ ሥር ለመኖሪያ ቤት ልክ የሚባል አይደለም።
ModelContractSection.contentOm: Yeroon kiraalee waggaa lama gadi hin buusu. Yeroon kanaan gadi ta'e mansiin jireenyaa kana jalatti seera qabaachaa hin qabu.

ModelContractSection.contentEn: The monthly rent is stated in birr and may not exceed the published ceiling. Payment is made only through bank transfer or legal electronic channel; the system records each payment and issues a receipt.
ModelContractSection.contentAm: ወርሃዊ ኪራይ በብር ይጠቀሳል፤ ከታተመው ጣሪያ ዋጋ በላይ መሆን አይችልም። ክፍያ በባንክ ወይም በሕጋዊ ኤሌክትሮኒክ መንገድ ብቻ ይከፈላል፤ ሥርዓቱ እያንዳንዱን ክፍያ ይመዝግብና ደረሰኝ ይሰጣል።
ModelContractSection.contentOm: Kiraan ji'aa qarshiin ni kaafama; gatii daangaa maxxanfame caalaa hin ta'u. Kaffaltiin karaa baankii ykn karaa elektiroonikii seera qabeessa qofaani kaffalama; sirni tokkoon tokkoo kaffaltii galmeessuu fi ragaa kaffaltii kenna.

ModelContractSection.contentEn: Advance payment demanded from the tenant may not exceed two months' rent.
ModelContractSection.contentAm: ከተከራዩ የሚጠየቅ የቅድመ ክፍያ ከሁለት ወር ኪራይ በላይ መሆን አይችልም።
ModelContractSection.contentOm: Kaffaltiin duraa kiraa fudhaataa irratti gaafatamu ji'a lama caalaa hin ta'u.

ModelContractSection.titleEn: Rights and Obligations of the Parties
ModelContractSection.contentEn: The landlord keeps the house habitable and lawful; the tenant uses the house for residence, pays on time, and observes the contract; both follow the proclamation and the directive.
ModelContractSection.contentAm: አከራዩ ቤቱ ለመኖር በሚስማማ ሁኔታና በሕግ እንዲሆን ያደርጋል፤ ተከራዩ ቤቱን ለመኖሪያነት ይጠቀማል፣ በጊዜው ይከፍላል፣ ውሉን ይከተላል፤ ሁለቱም አዋጁንና መመሪያውን ይከተላሉ።
ModelContractSection.contentOm: Kiraaleessi mana nyyata jireenyaaf gahaa fi seeraan ta'u taasisa; kiraa fudhaataan mana nyyata jireenyaf fayyada, yerootti kaffala, waliigalaa kabadha; lamaanuu labsii fi qajeelfama kabadhu.

ModelContractSection.contentEn: Any amendment to rent, term or parties is made in writing and registered within thirty working days of effect; unregistered amendments do not take legal effect.
ModelContractSection.contentAm: በኪራይ፣ በዘመን ወይም በወገኖች ላይ የሚደረግ ማንኛውም ማሻሻያ በጽሑፍ ሆኖ ከሥራ ላይ ከዋለ በኋላ በ30 የሥራ ቀናት ውስጥ ይመዘገባል፤ ያልተመዘገበ ማሻሻያ የሕግ ተግባር አይኖረውም።
ModelContractSection.contentOm: Fooyyessi kiraalaa, yeroo ykn gootota irratti ta'e qindaa'inaa waliin barreeffamee hoii seera qabeessa seenee booda guyyaa hojii 30 keessatti galmeefama; fooyyessi galmeen hin qabne bu'aa seera qabaachaa hin qabaatu.

ModelContractSection.contentEn: Complaints go first to the woreda office for settlement within thirty working days; appeals lie to the hearing committee within fifteen days of the decision; final administrative decisions are appealable to the courts.
ModelContractSection.contentAm: ይግባኝ በመጀመሪያ በወረዳ ቢሮ በ30 የሥራ ቀናት ውስጥ ለመፍታት ይቀርባል፤ ውሳኔውን ከተሰጠ በ15 ቀናት ውስጥ ወደ ሰሚያ ኮሚቴ ይገባል፤ የመጨረሻ የአስተዳደር ውሳኔ ወደ ፍርድ ቤት ሊጠየቅ ይችላል።
ModelContractSection.contentOm: Wal dhabbiinsi dura woreda keessatti guyyaa hojii 30 keessatti furmaata argata; murteessiin kennaa booda guyyaa 15 keessatti gara gargaarsa dhageettiatti darba; murteessiin bulchiinsa dhumaarraa courtitti darbuu danda'a.

ModelContractSection.contentEn: The contract is signed before three witnesses who write their names and identification numbers.
ModelContractSection.contentAm: ውሉ የሚታረሰው በሦስት ምስክሮች ፊት ሲሆን ምስክሮቹ ስማቸውንና የመታወቂያ ቁጥራቸውን ይጽፋሉ።
ModelContractSection.contentOm: Waliigalaan dura dhugaa baatoota sadiitti mallatteefama; dhugaa baatoonni maqaa isaanii fi lakkoofsa addaa baay'inaa qaamaa isaanii barreessu.

ModelContractSection.contentEn: The registrar certifies free will and signatures, verifies copies against originals, numbers attached documents, applies the round office stamp, assigns the contract number, and records the contract in the registry book and the database.
ModelContractSection.contentAm: መመዝጊው ነጻ ፈቃድና ፊርማዎችን ያረጋግጣል፣ ቅጂዎችን ከዋናው ጋር ያነጻጽራል፣ የተያያዙ ሰነዶችን ያቁጥራል፣ ዙራድ የቢሮ ማህተም ይጫናል፣ የውል ቁጥር ይሰጣል፣ ውሉንም በመዝገብ መጽሐፍና በኮምፒውተር ዳታቤዝ ይመዝግባል።
ModelContractSection.contentOm: Galmeessaan fedhii bilisaa fi mallatteewwan mirkaneessa, warabbiiwwan waliin qabeenyaan wal bira qaba, faayilota cufaman lakkoofsa, warqee waajjiraa suuqa, lakkoofsa waliigalaa kenna, waliigalichas galmeessuu fi daataabeessitti galmeessa.

Environment.name: rentctl-dev
Environment.purpose: Developer workspace and integration sandbox; configuration experiments and seed iteration.
Environment.backupScheme: Snapshot on every seed run; workspace version control retains configuration history.
Environment.restoreDrill: Restore from seed is deterministic; exercised on each promotion to STAGING.
Environment.notes: Represented in this workspace by the running Next.js application and its Prisma database.

Environment.name: rentctl-staging
Environment.purpose: Pre-production rehearsal: staged promotion target, validation suite, integration stubs for bank/payment and identification services.
Environment.database: SQLite (Prisma) - staging profile db/staging.db (production target: PostgreSQL cluster)
Environment.backupScheme: Nightly full backup plus continuous transaction logging; 30-day rolling retention.
Environment.restoreDrill: Quarterly restore rehearsal; result recorded in the operations log.
Environment.notes: Promotion gate: full validation battery (hierarchy, catalogues, trilingual completeness) must pass before PROD.

Environment.name: rentctl-prod
Environment.purpose: Live service for woreda offices, sub-city and Bureau consoles, and the public portal.
Environment.database: PostgreSQL primary per tier with read replica for reporting (production target)
Environment.backupScheme: Nightly full backup plus continuous transaction logging at every tier; hard-copy register custody per Directive Art. 13 (uniform numbered registry books, dual hard/soft custody).
Environment.replicationTarget: Upward change propagation: Woreda -> Sub-city -> Bureau -> Ministry
Environment.restoreDrill: Annual restore drill with evidenced result (NFR-03).
Environment.notes: Backups at every tier are a Directive Art. 13(4) obligation, not an operational option.

PublicationItem.titleEn: What a valid residential lease looks like
PublicationItem.titleAm: ትክክለኛ የመኖሪያ ቤት ውል ምን ይመስላል
PublicationItem.titleOm: Waliin kiraalaa dhugaa battumaa maal fakkaata
PublicationItem.contentEn: A valid lease is written on the Bureau model contract, certified at your woreda office, and registered within thirty days. Keep your certified copy; it is your legal protection.
PublicationItem.contentAm: ትክክለኛ ውል በቢሮው ሞዴል በጽሑፍ የተዘጋጀ፣ በወረዳ ጽሕፈት ቤት የተረጋገጠ እና በሰላሳ ቀን ውስጥ የተመዘገበ መሆን አለበት። የተረጋገጠውን ቅጂ ያስቀምጡ።
PublicationItem.contentOm: Waliin dhugaa waliin moodelaa Biirootiin barreeffame, waajjira woredaa keessatti mirkaneeffame, guyyaa 30 keessatti galmeeffame ta'uu qaba.

PublicationItem.titleEn: Pay your rent through the bank or legal electronic channels
PublicationItem.titleAm: ኪራያችሁን በባንክ ወይም በሕጋዊ ኤሌክትሮኒክ መንገድ ይክፈሉ
PublicationItem.titleOm: Kiraallee karaa baankii ykn elektiroonikii seera qabeessatti kaffalaa
PublicationItem.contentEn: The law requires rent to be paid only through banks or legal electronic channels. Cash payments expose both parties to penalties and are not recognized as legal rent payment.
PublicationItem.contentAm: ሕጉ ኪራይ በባንክ ወይም በሕጋዊ ኤሌክትሮኒክ መንገድ ብቻ እንዲከፈል ይጠይቃል። በጥሬ ገንዘብ ክፍያ ቅጣት ይጣላል።
PublicationItem.contentOm: Seeraan kiraalni karaa baankii ykn elektiroonikii seera qabeessa qofa akka kaffalamu barbaada.

AwarenessItem.bodyEn: A valid residential rent contract is written on the Bureau model contract, certified at your woreda, carries the office stamp, and is registered in the woreda registry book within 30 days. Keep your certified copy - it is your legal protection.

AwarenessItem.titleEn: Know your rights and duties under the rent proclamation
AwarenessItem.titleOm: Mirga fi dirqama kee kiraalaa beekuu
AwarenessItem.bodyEn: Rent is paid only through electronic channels; the advance cannot exceed two months; increases follow the published ceiling; disputes go to your woreda office first. Listen for the Bureau's weekly program on your local station.

AwarenessItem.bodyEn: Existing rent contracts must be presented at the woreda where the house is located within 30 days plus 3 grace days of the announcement. Registration protects both landlord and tenant.
